programs.title_fil: Local Senior Pension (pensyon ng lungsod para sa senior)
programs.for: Pasig residents aged 65 and above who are indigent (no financial support from family) and have no pension from SSS/GSIS or similar, except the DSWD social pension. Moneymax adds at least 2 years' residency in Pasig.
programs.benefit: ₱500 per month, released as ₱1,500 per quarter
programs.how: Register through your barangay's OSCA coordinator or the Office of Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA). Registration is free.

programs.title_fil: Pamaskong cash gift para sa senior citizen
programs.for: Pasig senior citizens; Moneymax says recipients must have been registered voters for at least 2 years
programs.benefit: ₱3,000 per year-end (per Moneymax); past releases were credited to Landbank ATM cash cards
programs.how: Withdraw from your Landbank cash card; follow the distribution schedule posted on the Pasig PIO Facebook page

programs.title_fil: Insentibo para sa 90 taong gulang pataas
programs.for: Pasig senior citizens aged 90 and above

programs.title_fil: Tulong pampalibing para sa senior citizen
programs.for: Family of a deceased holder of a Pasig OSCA ID

programs.title_fil: Libreng ospital, gamot at bakuna para sa senior
programs.title_en: Free hospitalization, medicines and vaccines for seniors
programs.benefit: Free hospitalization and prescription medicines at Pasig City General Hospital; free anti-pneumonia and anti-flu vaccines
programs.office: OSCA / Pasig City General Hospital / City Health Office

programs.title_fil: Buwanang ayuda para sa solo parent
programs.for: Registered solo parents on the city's beneficiary list (4,276 in the September 2025 payout)
programs.benefit: ₱1,000 per month (the September 2025 payout covered April-June: ₱3,000). The national Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act also provides ₱1,000 monthly to qualified solo parents.
programs.how: Paid by ATM card; the first batch was distributed at barangays. Ask your barangay. A representative may claim with an authorization letter (immediate family/relatives only).
programs.office: City Social Welfare and Development Office / barangay

programs.for: Pasig persons with disability (PWD ID holders)
programs.benefit: ₱1,500 (October 2025 release of unclaimed 2024 gifts to about 2,000 PWDs)
programs.how: Claim on the date for your surname, with proof of identity and Pasig residency; an authorized representative may claim
programs.note: Not confirmed as a recurring annual amount.

programs.title_fil: Tulong pinansyal para sa negosyong PWD
programs.title_en: Financial assistance for PWD-run small businesses
programs.for: PWDs (or their guardians) already running a micro/small business in Pasig; 200 slots in the 2023 round
programs.how: Submit business profile, short letter, barangay certificate of indigency, PWD ID and valid ID copies, and business photos in person at PDAO
programs.office: Persons with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO), (02) 643-1111 loc. 1162

programs.for: Filipino, Pasig resident for 2+ years, Listahanan-listed or household income ≤ ₱30,000/month, enrolled in a priority program at a partner private HEI/TVI in Pasig (e.g., Pasig Catholic College, Arellano University-Andres Bonifacio Campus), with no other scholarship
programs.benefit: Up to ₱35,000 per semester covering tuition, other school fees and a fixed allowance for books, supplies and expenses, until course completion
programs.how: Apply online via the Pasig City Scholarship Portal when the window opens; announced on the Pasig City Scholarship Office Facebook page

programs.for: College students who pass ranking; 1,789 selected from 3,389 eligible applicants in one cycle
programs.how: Apply when the city opens the cycle; non-selected applicants can appeal to the PCS office within 5 working days

programs.title_en: Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Pasig (city university)
programs.for: Incoming freshmen with GWA ≥ 80% whose applicant/parent/guardian has lived in Pasig for 5+ years; qualified 2nd/3rd-year transferees (GWA 2.25 or better)
programs.benefit: City-run university created by Ordinance No. 11 s. 1999. Tuition terms were not stated in the sources.
programs.how: Online application when announced on the PLP Facebook page
programs.note: Requirements are from the 2023 admission cycle.

programs.for: Kindergarten to Grade 12 public school students under DepEd-Pasig
programs.office: City Government of Pasig / DepEd Pasig

programs.for: Patients enrolled in the Pasig Mental Health Program (non-residents also served, per the Mental Health Office)
programs.benefit: Free medicines (22 types in stock as of January 2026, DOH-supplied)
programs.how: Register at the nearest barangay health center; bring a valid prescription, a valid ID and a medical certificate if available
programs.office: Pasig City Mental Health Office / barangay health centers

programs.benefit: City QR system used for COVID-19 contact tracing and as registration for vaccination; current uses not confirmed
programs.note: Based on search-result titles from 2020-2021; no source for present-day uses.
